what_happened.line: The Economic Development Committee met remotely and put off approving its prior minutes to a later in-person meeting, with copies to go out digitally.
Members agreed to put a September meet and greet and a December holiday business crawl on the committee's goals list.
The committee also discussed an agricultural fair, a shared events calendar, the vacant center storefront, the warehouse and Lofa Farms projects, and a regional round table; no votes were taken.
The next meeting was set for February 22nd at six o'clock, in person.

why_it_matters: This committee works on local business events and town-center activity; the goals list is where such events start, and no budget item or vote was attached at this meeting.
watch_next: The February 22nd in-person meeting, where the deferred approval of the prior minutes is expected to be taken up.
